parameters.subject: Thank you for applying to FloLabs
parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $node["ParseHubSpotForm"].json["first_name"]}},

Thank you for applying to our internship at FloLabs!

My name is Paula and below I'm including information on the next steps. If you'd like to connect with me on LinkedIn, please do so https://www.linkedin.com/company/flo-labs-r-d/.

We’re excited to share that we’re working on innovative products and services in AI, AGI, and Robotics. Our diverse range of new projects covers education, travel and hospitality, healthcare, animal science, and the space sector. While some of our most high-profile projects involve artificial intelligence and humanoid robotics, our teams also include front-end developers, visual designers, media creators, product strategists, and many more. Whatever your background, whether it's in code, content, administration or creativity, there’s space to contribute meaningfully.

Most recently, we’ve launched a new project focused on the development of our own humanoid robot - a major milestone in our mission to push the boundaries of intelligent systems and human-robot interaction. Interns who join us may have the opportunity to contribute directly to this groundbreaking initiative.

FloLabs is soon launching Texas Advanced Robotics Research Lab (TARRL.org) - a center dedicated to advanced research, architecture, and prototyping, designed for PhDs and experienced researchers. In parallel, we are building a remote-access robotics lab on the island of Lemnos, Greece, where participants will be able to access our robot training facility virtually from anywhere in the world.

Our participants gain hands-on exposure not only to robotics but also to every aspect of a commercial enterprise, including business and entrepreneurship, operations and project management, legal and ethics, finance, design, sales and marketing, and technology.

Here are some of our active ventures that interns may contribute to:

  • RoboCollective.ai – a robot store featuring our in-house–developed humanoid.
  • CAIPO.ai – a wearable AI personal assistant.
  • MoodChanger.ai – CAIPO integrated with third-party wearables for applications in education, healthcare, sports, travel, hospitality, pets, and more.
  • FloStudios.ai – a design and marketing agency for creatives and creators.
  • FlomadTravel – an AI-powered travel planner and assistant.
  • LegalEthicsVenturesInstitute.com- a Legal and Ethics startup venture studio and experiential learning platform.

Since many applicants are students or working professionals, we have designed our internship to be highly flexible and fully remote. The minimum commitment is 8 to 10 hours per week, and you have full flexibility in how you schedule that time. Most meetings are offered at different times so you can join the ones that work best for you, and all sessions are recorded for later viewing. If personal or academic circumstances require it, you can also pause the internship and resume when you are ready.

Due to the high demand, we’ve developed a structured program with multiple opportunities to involve as many passionate interns as possible. To distinguish those who are truly serious and passionate from those who are not, we have a thorough selection process that we go through. This involves providing feedback on key information and questions, as well as asking candidates to review our websites and additional materials. Rather than relying on resumes alone, we invite applicants to share their perspectives, interests, and feedback on what we do. This allows us to better understand where you might thrive and gives you a chance to see if our projects, values, and culture feel like the right fit.

👉 Next Step (Required): Please watch the meeting recording below. It provides important background on our projects and the internship experience:

Click here to access the meeting recording

Click here to access the meeting recording

After watching, simply reply to this email to confirm whether you’d like to move forward. Once we receive your confirmation, we’ll share additional details about the next stage of the process.

You can also explore our LinkedIn Company Page https://www.linkedin.com/company/flo-labs-r-d/ to learn more.

We've noticed that some of our emails may not be reaching recipients. If you're not interested, just let us know so we don't waste either of our time following up and we’ll remove you from our list.

Sincerely,
HR Team
FloLabs Innovations Group
